headline: Neogen Chemicals Limited: Press Release
sum: Press Release - Neogen Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 21, 2026, titled "Neogen Chemicals raises approx INR 600 Crore via its first ever QIP Issue Oversubscribed by 6.5x".
